Disabling infer_dimensions skips the decode step and still produces content

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>No dims: <img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==" alt="pixel"></p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_images: true, infer_dimensions: false))
puts result.content.inspect
```
